name: Animation Pack
author: DevsBlink

sections.description:
Animation Pack adds powerful animations for Elementor and Gutenberg content. It allows you to create smooth, customizable animations without adding extra blocks or widgets. Enhance your existing Elementor sections or Gutenberg content with advanced animations that are fully responsive and cross-browser compatible.

Key Features

  • Adds advanced animations to Elementor & Gutenberg
  • Fully customizable animation effects
  • Smooth and high-performance animations
  • Cross-browser compatible
  • Fully responsive
  • No additional widgets or blocks required
sections.faq:
Can I use this plugin without Elementor or Gutenberg?

No. Animation Pack works only with Elementor or Gutenberg content.

Does it work with any theme?

Yes! It works with any theme that supports Elementor or Gutenberg.
